---
title: "About"
---

I am Faran Abbas, a graduate student in World Economy at Shandong University. You can view my work on [GitHub](https://github.com/faranabbas-repo) or contact me at [faranabbas@hotmail.com](mailto:faranabbas@hotmail.com).

This project analyzes the drivers of economic growth across more than 180 countries from 2000-2023 using World Bank World Development Indicators. Through cross-sectional and panel-data methods, the analysis identifies investment, trade openness, and labor market conditions as important correlates of GDP growth. You can view the repository [here](https://github.com/faranabbas-repo/global-economic-growth-analysis).

This project was developed as part of [Kane's Data Science Bootcamp](https://bootcamp.davidkane.info/).
